schema.title: C4OS Grill Question 013 - Center Pane And Panel Resize

questions.label: What should the center chat pane minimum width be?
questions.help: Recommended: 560px minimum. It is wide enough for readable chat composition and responses while leaving room for one or two side panels on common desktop widths.
options: Use responsive breakpoint rules instead of one fixed value

questions.label: What happens when side panels would shrink the center below its minimum?
questions.help: Recommended: stop resizing at the center minimum and prevent panels from expanding further. This keeps the chat pane usable and predictable.
options: Stop panel expansion at the center minimum
Allow center to shrink and rely on responsive layout

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether panel widths persist per chat session, per plugin, or globally, and whether narrow windows should force panels closed.
